runs.pr_body:
## first_words in textkit/tokens.py returns one more word than requested instead of exactly the first n words.

Closes: Fix first_words returning one word too many

### Plan
- Inspect first_words in textkit/tokens.py to locate the off-by-one causing n+1 words to be returned
- Fix first_words to return exactly the first n words, preserving the n <= 0 empty-string and fewer-than-n full-text cases
- Add a regression test to tests/test_tokens_regression.py covering first_words('alpha beta gamma delta', 2) == 'alpha beta'
- Run the new regression test and all existing tests to verify the fix and no regressions

### Files changed
- textkit/tokens.py
- tests/test_tokens_regression.py

### Tests
All tests pass (10 → 11 discovered).

### Regression gate
Verified: suite fails on baseline production code, so the new tests demonstrate the claimed change.

### Issue-target gate
Verified: the fix changes the issue's named target(s): first_words.

### Reviewer
approve: Checked diff limited to first_words fix (words[:n+1] to words[:n]) in textkit/tokens.py plus new regression test; no unrelated changes. Tests pass (10 to 11), regression gate passes (fails on baseline), target gate confirms first_words changed, and test_first_words_returns_exact_count covers the fix.
